mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (task_id, user_id, role, content, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1 FROM chat_messages WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT id, task_id, user_id, role, content, sort_order, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
